asr.full_text: Hello friends, how are you all? Welcome to Health Q Channel. Today, I am going to talk about problem of slipped disc. What is the difference between the problem of slipped disc and the one of a normal back pain? How does it work? How will the back treated, how is the treatment, diagnosis? And some more basic details and information about it are going to be shared with you in today's video. So if you have back pain, or if you have doubts like is this slip disk? Is this mechanical low back pain? And if you have read any of these terms and you do not know what exactly the problem of slip disk all, this video is for you. So do watch this video till the end. Let us start. of the lumbar oral cervical disc! What does this mean? The things you think are sitting beneath one another like blocks in between both the joints there is a lump and this is known as Disc. There is a lot of liquid, protein based material in this disc which acts as a support, shock absorption as well as the nutrition supply which leads to many different functions. However, the liquid components of the disc start to come out due to over pressure and as the liquid material comes out the structure in the spinal cord overpressure. It will be released such a way that other structures inside the spinal cord, may be present there and sometimes, it release outwards and creates pressure. It is not complete liquid, you can call it paste form material, okay. If it leaves from inside then it creates pressure on the spinal cord and n the nerves is pressing you get the symptoms. So basically RAT means herniation of the material inside the disc. This does not mean that the disc has slipped different or the whole bone got out. Its not like that. Its just the herniation. So its very important to understand about this. These problems typically are experienced by people who use the forward bent bend. And that too because of the spine. There are 2 kinds of forward bending. First is when you start with forward bending of the hip the first one is done using the hip and second is do it whole from front like we sit while sweeping or we lift up the fallen items so many people do the activity so much repeatedly that it causes slip disc problem Slip disc problems don't the problem of one day. So, if you suddenly feel pain then it is very wrong to think that I did a thing and therefore my disc completely moved and I have problem with slipped disc. Yes, it is possible that if you have an accident or you fell very fast or you fell too fast then there is possibility that you to have slip discs. But this can happen in a very rare case. Mostly, a slip disc develops from an over period of time. It means you may have experienced a mechanical low back pain before and yet, you have continued that same activity and kept on leaning forward and slowly, its effect started to effect your disc due to the stress on it the liquid or paste material from it started to come out So for treating this most important thing is you should stop bending forward or have a habit to bend forward and this we do so many times in a day and we don't aware that Or else you'll have to reduce the process of bending in the forward direction It's the habit of forward bending and we repeat it so many times that we don't know we immediately bend and carry anything falling down and then you will start to return firmly Thus this habit creates this problem of split disc Second issue is, if slip disc is a problem according to research or studies In men, the frequency of slip frequency is high. I mean, males are more prone to develop slip disc, or else inter-vertebral disc problem compared to women. Now, let's come to the second parameter which is important to know. If thousands of people have issues of back pain, from that, 5 to 20% of people will have back pain due to the problem of slipped disc This is a small but very important group It is very important to have its diagnosis and treatment People who come in this age group under 30 to 50 years their chances are more to develop slip disc problem This may happen It may be true sometimes It can also happen in that age group. Many a times this can happen and many people suffer for a longer period. If you have a CT scan or MRI, you can find that but if you see a patient or a human being, they will not have any issues. When the disk material has got released its not irritating the other structures it is not irritating the tissues it has just left its place But as your age gets increased as weakness develops in your muscles when your strength for bones gets decreased weakness in muscles the speed of your power loss these herniation materials will start creating problems then you'll experience a back pain that's why people experience a back pain even after 50 years it's not an issue for Puranis but you know it comes later Slip disc problem disk exists in 2 ways in neck & in the waist. in neck & in the waist. neck's slip disk is not common but waist's slip disk is quite common if you are familiar in neck bones or our joint is called cervical disc which are like in thoracic or upper back region are known as thoracic bone and lower back bone is known as lumbar region the bones are like a line and it's given with numbers these are very good bones that show the lines that make the numbers so the problem with the slip disc is L4 and L5 the 4th and 5th number of the cartilage commonly in the middle this chance of slip will be much and the other L5 and S1 which means the 5th number and and also the sacrum bone or tail bone there is a common herniation in that disc that is why lip disc of L4 L5 level or S1 level lip disc is common about ninety-five percent of people in the have shown problem of slip disc so what are the symptoms like? what are the causes of slip disc disease the first problem is back pain Many people don't have back pain they do suffer sensory symptoms. Means... On the legs there are current types of sensations Many people who suffer from ants in the legs And many people feel the pain on the knees means they feel an electric shock on the knees and the same on the waist It is like the feeling, sensation, which goes down. Some people may feel weakness of leg and some people get back pain. Back pain is present but also comes with radiculopathy, which means that pain, sensory symptoms all would go in the legs which causes knee pain, sensory and ankle problems. These people are difficult to walk by walking lot of times. It feels as if the life had gone in the legs. We find this type of symptoms in the casevertebral Disc or SLIP DISC Now let's talk about its Diagnosis How to recognize it? How to get a diagnosis from it? As usually, I am not able to make a diagnosis of your disease. nor you can have a diagnosis from this at your home That's why it is very important to go to an Orthopaedic Surgeon and get the test done When you go to an Orthopaedic surgeon, he will take your history. He will do physical examination. He will touch you & see the points at which you are facing problem. He will provide you some physical test. So, what is a provocative test? Provocative test is done by just one physical move on the body. The period we perform such physical tests. in which the pain increases When pain increases, it is a sign to find out at which level it is damaged. We will do provocative tests along with it. Also we recommend you to do other tests such as x-ray, Ct scan, MRI and if there are many neurological symptoms then EMG and NCV test has to be prescribed. There are some conditions with which differentiating is very important. Because when you find out what the cause of the problem is then only it will come under treatment. So which are the similar problems that produce exactly similar symptoms? The first problem is spondylitis, Lumbar Spondylitis Many people think of spondylitis spondylitis is different because it is caused due to aging, because of the degeneration that happens when the gap between spinel bones that are kept within the spine. So, we also get to see the same symptoms with spondylitis. In addition to this, HANKE LOSING SPONDYLITIS This is an auto-immune disorder. The spine gets completely tightened like a bamboo stick. That is why the pain around the waist is felt. A second neurological problem is called CHRONICAL CHORO-AUTO PERSPECTIVE People are usually suffering from this disorder from the early childhood. Second problem is called Cauda Equana Ssyndrome that happens to people from birth. It is a structure that has been referred to as Spinal Cord Pooch. which means we find the whole nerves as a pipe-tube at the end of the spinal Cord This area is called Cauda Equana Sometimes pressure is feel , if it is not developed properly then these symptoms start coming but there are more neurological signs like there are small ball bladders i.e. control of urine these things get involved apart from this, we experience mechanical back pain We experience a lot of muscle strain or muscle pull due to which we experience severe back pain and people think I they have slip disc. So, it is necessary to follow a different diagnoses. And many the cases people face two problems that are arthritis in the knee and mechanical lower back pain in the waist. Then patients will complain both that their legs hurts and back as well. Even then doctor will make them think that this is a problem of lumbar slip disc or is it something else so its important to do diagnosis and the last one which is Myofacial Pain means that our muscles structure inside it, sometimes get tight at some points, there are tissue clumps and these create a problem this is also an important reason It has structure like this it can be tight at some points it can form a cluster of cells and this creates problems and this is important cause of back pain So it important to differentiate all these symptoms and problems To determine treatments Now let's discuss , if it is a slip disc then what are the treatments? As usual treatment can be divided into 3 parts One is medical management. 2nd is surgical management. 3rd is physiotherapy management. Other than physiotherapy management, there are also alternative therapies. But first let's discuss about medical management. In medical management, there are most often medication such as anti-inflammatories, pain-inimiting medications or epidural blocks like injection to-block in injected to block pain. This happens in the conservative management. In surgery treatment physical therapy also stops working, medicines too does not help and more and more slip disc occurs where the spinal cord is being suppressed and patient's ball bladder control i.e. controlling ur means that it does not work normally and they get aggravated symptoms and the surgery is done by doing that and as usual that is also the main treatment which is Physiotherapy And this is very important and also a very good role because you can improve it long term and maintain the condition so usually when the patient's visit to physiotherapist he takes the pain problems So let's reduce those pains with the help of Electrical Modalities, Thermotherapy or also we can use Mobilization and manipulation techniques and there are some advanced therapies such as Dry Needling and Cupbing Therapy There are many advance therapies such as dry needling and cupping therapies . These are also used a lot by physiotherapists and this is used to reduce the level of pain. These are also helpful in healing to a certain extent and for the parallele inflammation developed in muscles. Now apart from machines.. Next comes about positioning. We we give ergonomical advice to this like how to sit, when to walk, which exercises can be avoided, and do which activities, so this is the important role of counseling for Physiotherapist and with this counseling we move towards the exercise In the exercise, the focus is to be able to increase the flexibility of muscles and strength After these basic exercises we move on to the next level where we focus on core muscle strengthening so that you can increase your power of muscles in your waist so in this we can apply planks, Ironman exercises by focusing on muscle strengthening or strengthening your back muscles like in this, planks, ironman for exercise, pilates, yoga can be used such an advanced exercise format with you help, you can manage it well and so this was a brief video about slip disc that means Prolapse Intervertebral Disc I hope you will find this video informative if you you liked the video. If you liked it, please like the video and share it with those people who have back pain. I will meet you next week.
